takenRequests.title: Champion commission
takenRequests.description: 35–50 minutes. Walk or march easily for 3–5 minutes, then do three easy practice repetitions of each movement. Warm-up repetitions are separate from work sets. Complete Leg press: 3 × 6–10; Machine chest press: 3 × 6–10; Seated cable row: 3 × 6–10; Dumbbell Romanian deadlift: 3 × 6–10; Dead bug: 3 × 6–10 per side. Rest 90–120 seconds between work sets. Finish each set with about 2–3 clean repetitions in reserve. Record the same variation, load and range for comparisons. Complete the class focus: Build advanced strength, training consistency, and confidence.

workout.warmup: Walk or march easily for 3–5 minutes, then do three easy practice repetitions of each movement. Warm-up repetitions are separate from work sets.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cues: Use a stable chair against a wall when needed, with hand assistance if necessary. Keep feet planted, lower under control and use a repeatable comfortable depth. Record the assistance.
exercises.progress: Add repetitions first; then reduce hand assistance, lower the target slightly or use a small load increase.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable grip. Lower under control; keep shoulders and trunk stable. Stop before technique changes.
exercises.progress: Increase the smallest available load after two comparable top-range sessions.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cues: Keep the trunk stable. Pull the elbow back without shrugging or twisting; lower under control.
exercises.progress: Keep the same range and support. Add reps, then a small measurable load increase.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cues: Begin with a light familiar load. Soften the knees, send hips back and keep the load close; stop at a range you can control without rounding.
exercises.progress: Increase reps before load and retain the same controlled range.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cues: Lie on your back. Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly while keeping the trunk still; shorten the reach to retain control.
exercises.progress: Increase repetitions, then lengthen the reach while keeping the trunk still. Speed is not the progression target.

takenRequests.title: Brisk walk for 30 minutes
takenRequests.description: Walk easily for 2–3 minutes, then complete a 30-minute brisk block at a pace where conversation is possible but singing is difficult. Finish with 2–3 easy minutes. Record brisk minutes separately from the warm-up and cool-down; five completed brisk blocks provide 150 moderate minutes.
